ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity dark pigment to high-intensity white/grey pigment across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) contiguous mass in the medial and central fluke regions. High-intensity (white/light grey) mottling is present on the lateral portions of both lobes, particularly the distal 30% of the left lobe, which contains discrete dark circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation approximately 140 degrees, with the central vertex partially obscured by water turbulence/spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth, most pronounced at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex arc from the notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, irregular, raised pixel groups indicative of barnacle colonization are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical high-intensity linear mark is visible on the inner-medial section of the left lobe, cutting through the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white linear rake marks on the left lobe; significant irregular mass accumulation (parasitic/barnacle) at distal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: White-water spray and cascading droplets creating localized high-intensity pixel noise at the trailing edge and median notch.
